argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Call me Ishmael. Some years ago—never mind how long precisely—having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world. It is a way I have of driving off the spleen and regulating the circulation. Whenever I find myself growing grim about the mouth; whenever it is a damp, drizzly November in my soul; whenever I find myself involuntarily pausing before coffin warehouses, and bringing up the rear of every funeral I meet; and especially whenever my hypos get such an upper hand of me, that it requires a strong moral principle to prevent me from deliberately stepping into the street, and methodically knocking people's hats off—then, I account it high time to get to sea as soon as I can. This is my substitute for pistol and ball. With a philosophical flourish Cato throws himself upon his sword; I quietly take to the ship. There is nothing surprising in this. If they but knew it, almost all men in their degree, some time or other, cherish very nearly the same feelings towards the ocean with me.
</passage>

response.text:
The identifier "Ishmael" is to be utilized, going forward, for attribution purposes, though the precision of any temporal baseline should not be considered fully operationalized at this time. At some point prior to present, characterized by a suboptimal liquidity position and an absence of clearly defined shore-based value-adds, a strategic pivot toward maritime engagement was conceptualized, with the broader objective of achieving exposure to aquatic-sector environments at scale. This may or may not represent a recurring behavioral framework, one which is leveraged, on an as-needed basis, for the mitigation of affective downturns and the general recalibration of circulatory alignment.

In instances where facial affect trends toward grimness, or where an internal November-like condition is said to obtain (metaphorically, if such framing is permissible), or where an involuntary orientation toward mortuary-adjacent retail infrastructure is observed, or where an unsolicited tendency to trail behind funerary processions manifests, or—perhaps most saliently, though this too is offered with appropriate caveats—where hypothetical low-mood states achieve such a degree of dominance that considerable moral bandwidth is required to forestall the deliberate, methodical removal of pedestrians' headwear on public thoroughfares, a determination is typically reached that maritime deployment should be operationalized without further delay. This is positioned, tentatively, as a functional substitute for more terminal alternatives. Where Cato is understood to have resolved matters via bladed self-intervention, a comparable resolution is instead pursued through vessel-based reallocation, albeit without the philosophical flourish.

No particular surprise should be inferred from any of the above. It might be suggested, with all due hedging, that a broad cross-section of stakeholders, across varying degrees and at various life-stages, harbor—perhaps unknowingly, perhaps not—a substantially analogous alignment with oceanic phenomena.
